sentences.text: Four genes, IDUA, HGSNAT, NAGLU and SGSH, are all recorded as taking part in the same pathway for breaking down a sugar chain called heparan sulfate [e_a90ca7f18504] [e_654c35082eb6] [e_b88b530788ef] [e_5b584a90f37e].
These pathway links are curated, which means they come from the Reactome database [e_a90ca7f18504] [e_654c35082eb6].
Constellate computed that mucopolysaccharidosis type 1 and type 3 have a moderately similar symptom profile, with a score of 0.258 over 21 shared terms, ranked 3 of 5 [e_d759ca4ddc42].
This similarity is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it, and it is not a database finding [e_d759ca4ddc42].

Type 1 is linked to the gene IDUA and type 3 to the genes GNS and HGSNAT, but these gene links are inferred from subtypes at confidence 0.475 and may not hold for every form [e_62efcb079493] [e_31e8d8274b07] [e_ed375158e5b0].
Type 3 has two studies on ClinicalTrials.gov, a gene therapy study that is not yet recruiting and a cannabidiol study that is recruiting [e_293f8f633c73] [e_1246a2f623f5].
The Cure Sanfilippo Foundation is linked to type 3 only by an automatic name match, so treat that link as inferred [e_a1a9b68fc263].
These edges do not show that the type 3 studies apply to type 1, and they do not show that a drug works [e_293f8f633c73] [e_1246a2f623f5] [e_d759ca4ddc42].
